backups_ready_has_file.name: backups_ready_has_file
backups_ready_has_file.value: "backups"."status" <> 'ready' or ("backups"."object_key" is not null and "backups"."bytes" is not null)

dealerships_geo.name: dealerships_geo
dealerships_geo.value: (("dealerships"."lat" is null) = ("dealerships"."lng" is null)) and coalesce("dealerships"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "dealerships"."lng" between -180 and 180, true)

workshops_geo.name: workshops_geo
workshops_geo.value: (("workshops"."lat" is null) = ("workshops"."lng" is null)) and coalesce("workshops"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "workshops"."lng" between -180 and 180, true)

listings_geo.name: listings_geo
listings_geo.value: (("listings"."lat" is null) = ("listings"."lng" is null)) and coalesce("listings"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "listings"."lng" between -180 and 180, true)

promotions_dates.name: promotions_dates
promotions_dates.value: "promotions"."status" = 'pending_payment' or ("promotions"."starts_at" is not null and "promotions"."ends_at" is not null)
